name: aegis-id-dev
description: Root dev orchestration only — not a published package. The real projects are src/Aegis.Api (ASP.NET Core) and web/ (Angular), which stay independently deployable; this just starts both together for local development.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,dashboard -c blue,green "dotnet run --project src/Aegis.Api" "npm --prefix web start"
